user.title: Add MoLight entities
user.description: Create a single virtual entity, discover existing entities to wrap in bulk, or wire one sensor into several lights at once.

menu_options.assign_sensor: Assign a sensor to several lights

assign_sensor.title: Assign a sensor to lights
assign_sensor.description: Attach one virtual sensor to several virtual lights at once. Pick the kind of sensor to assign.

assign_occupancy.title: Assign an occupancy sensor
assign_occupancy.description: Choose the occupancy sensor and how it should drive the lights.

data_description.assign_role: Regular occupancy turns lights on and off; Maintain only holds an already-on light on while occupied.

assign_illuminance.title: Assign an illuminance sensor
assign_illuminance.description: Choose the illuminance sensor and how it should drive the lights.

data_description.illuminance_mode: Control: turning bright also forces the lights off. Gate: bright only blocks turn-ons — use when the lux sensor can see these lights, which would otherwise oscillate.

assign_schedule.title: Assign a schedule sensor
assign_schedule.description: Choose the schedule sensor and how it should drive the lights.

data_description.schedule_mode: Follow: on at window start, off at window end (porch lights). Gate: occupancy may only activate the lights inside the window.

assign_lights.title: Choose the lights
assign_lights.description: Lights already using this sensor are pre-selected. The final selection is the complete set that will use it: add lights to assign the sensor, deselect pre-selected ones to remove it.

create.title: Create a MoLight virtual entity
create.description: Pick the kind of virtual entity to create. Sensors must exist before the virtual light that references them.

discover_occupancy.title: Discover occupancy sensors
discover_occupancy.description: Optionally narrow the occupancy/motion/presence sensors offered on the next step. Leave the filters empty to see them all. Sensors already wrapped by MoLight, and disabled ones, are never offered.

data_description.filter_areas: Optional. Only offer sensors in these areas (the entity's own area, or its device's).
data_description.filter_labels: Optional. Only offer sensors carrying at least one of these labels (on the entity or its device).
data_description.preselect_all: On: the next step starts with every match checked — deselect the few you don't want. Off: it starts empty — check just the ones you want.

discover_occupancy_select.title: Discover occupancy sensors
discover_occupancy_select.description: Select the occupancy/motion/presence sensors to wrap in virtual occupancy sensors; the next step lets you adjust the defaults applied to all of them.

data_description.affix_prefix: Optional. Added before each name exactly as typed — include your own separator, e.g. "Auto ".
data_description.affix_suffix: Optional. Added after each name exactly as typed — include your own separator, e.g. " (auto)".
data_description.affix_target: Entity ID only keeps each virtual entity's name identical to the real one it wraps; Name changes the name and the entity ID derived from it.

discover_illuminance.title: Discover illuminance sensors
discover_illuminance.description: Optionally narrow the illuminance (lux) sensors offered on the next step. Leave the filters empty to see them all. Sensors already wrapped by MoLight, and disabled ones, are never offered.

data_description.filter_areas: Optional. Only offer sensors in these areas (the entity's own area, or its device's).
data_description.filter_labels: Optional. Only offer sensors carrying at least one of these labels (on the entity or its device).
data_description.preselect_all: On: the next step starts with every match checked — deselect the few you don't want. Off: it starts empty — check just the ones you want.

discover_illuminance_select.title: Discover illuminance sensors
discover_illuminance_select.description: Select the illuminance (lux) sensors to wrap in virtual illuminance sensors; the next step lets you adjust the defaults applied to all of them.

data_description.affix_prefix: Optional. Added before each name exactly as typed — include your own separator, e.g. "Auto ".
data_description.affix_suffix: Optional. Added after each name exactly as typed — include your own separator, e.g. " (auto)".
data_description.affix_target: Entity ID only keeps each virtual entity's name identical to the real one it wraps; Name changes the name and the entity ID derived from it.

discover_light.title: Discover lights
discover_light.description: Optionally narrow the lights offered on the next step. Leave the filters empty to see them all. Lights already wrapped by MoLight, and disabled ones, are never offered.

data_description.filter_areas: Optional. Only offer lights in these areas (the entity's own area, or its device's).
data_description.filter_labels: Optional. Only offer lights carrying at least one of these labels (on the entity or its device).
data_description.preselect_all: On: the next step starts with every match checked — deselect the few you don't want. Off: it starts empty — check just the ones you want.

discover_light_select.title: Discover lights
discover_light_select.description: Select the lights to wrap in virtual lights; the next step lets you adjust the defaults applied to all of them — including occupancy, illuminance, and schedule references.

data_description.affix_prefix: Optional. Added before each name exactly as typed — include your own separator, e.g. "Auto ".
data_description.affix_suffix: Optional. Added after each name exactly as typed — include your own separator, e.g. " (auto)".
data_description.affix_target: Entity ID only keeps each virtual entity's name identical to the real one it wraps; Name changes the name and the entity ID derived from it.

discover_occupancy_defaults.title: Occupancy sensor defaults
discover_occupancy_defaults.description: These settings are applied to every entity you're adding. Adjust them if you like — each one can also be edited individually later via its Configure button.

data_description.occupancy_timeout: The source sensor's own hold time, in seconds. When it clears, the moment the person actually left is estimated as clear time − timeout (the latest_occupied_time attribute, which anchors light countdowns).

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Expert tuning — the defaults suit most sensors.

data_description.false_detection_grace: A cycle that ends within this many seconds after the hold timeout contained a single instantaneous detection — almost certainly a false trigger (a fly, a heat blip). Flagged so lights lit by it can turn off quickly. 0 disables.
data_description.clear_on_unavailable_timeout: If the source stays unavailable this many seconds while occupancy is active, occupancy clears so a dead sensor can't hold lights on forever. 0 disables (occupancy then holds its last value).

discover_illuminance_defaults.title: Illuminance sensor defaults
discover_illuminance_defaults.description: These settings are applied to every entity you're adding. Adjust them if you like — each one can also be edited individually later via its Configure button.

data_description.illuminance_threshold: Lux level at or above which it counts as bright (sensor on, no artificial light needed); below it counts as dark (sensor off).
data_description.illuminance_hysteresis: Dead band that stops flapping around the threshold: becomes bright only at threshold + hysteresis, dark only below threshold − hysteresis. 0 disables.

discover_light_defaults.title: Light defaults
discover_light_defaults.description: These settings are applied to every entity you're adding. Adjust them if you like — each one can also be edited individually later via its Configure button.

data_description.light_timeout: Seconds the lights stay on after the last activity — or after occupancy clears — before turning off. Must be at least the referenced occupancy sensor's timeout (if one is specified).

sensors.name: Sensors & triggers
sensors.description: The virtual sensors and helper entities that drive the lights — all optional. Each mode sits next to the sensor it applies to.

data_description.occupancy_entity: Optional. A MoLight occupancy sensor (simple or combined): turns the lights on when the room is occupied and holds them until it clears.
data_description.maintain_occupancy_entity: Optional. Holds an already-on light on while it shows presence but never turns it on — however the light was lit.
data_description.illuminance_entity: Optional. A MoLight illuminance sensor; occupancy only turns the lights on while it reports dark.
data_description.illuminance_mode: Control: turning bright also forces the lights off. Gate: bright only blocks turn-ons — use when the lux sensor can see these lights, which would otherwise oscillate.
data_description.schedule_entity: Optional. A MoLight schedule sensor that drives or limits the lights by time window, per the schedule mode.
data_description.schedule_mode: Follow: on at window start, off at window end (porch lights). Gate: occupancy may only activate the lights inside the window.
data_description.door_entity: Optional. A door/contact binary sensor; opening it turns the lights on, gated by darkness and a gate-mode window exactly like occupancy.
data_description.door_mode: On open: opening turns the lights on with the normal timeout; the door is otherwise ignored. Open & close: the lights stay on while the door is open and start the countdown when it closes, unless occupancy still holds them.
data_description.hold_entities: Optional. While any of these is on, every automatic turn-off is suspended — guest mode, movie night. Turn-ons and manual control still work.

behavior.name: Turn-on & turn-off behavior
behavior.description: Optional brightness and fade overrides for automatic turn-ons and turn-offs, the quick-off delay after a false detection, and a turn-on selection applied before MoLight turns the lights on. Manual control is never affected, except that the turn-on selection also covers manual Virtual Light turn-ons (never physical ones).

data_description.false_detection_off_delay: When occupancy clears flagged as a false trigger, lights lit by that cycle turn off after this short delay instead of the full timeout. Manually turned-on lights are never cut short.
data_description.auto_on_brightness: Optional. Brightness for automatic turn-ons (occupancy, darkness, schedule). Manual and wall-switch turn-ons keep their own brightness; blank leaves automatic turn-ons at the lights' default too.
data_description.auto_on_color_temp: Optional. White color temperature (Kelvin) for automatic turn-ons, applied to lights that support it. Manual and wall-switch turn-ons keep their own color. Set either this or the auto-on color, not both.
data_description.auto_on_rgb_color: Optional. Color for automatic turn-ons, applied to lights that can show it. Manual and wall-switch turn-ons keep their own color. Set either this or the auto-on color temperature, not both.
data_description.turn_on_select_entity: Optional. The target select entity to set before this Virtual Light turns on, such as a WLED preset, theme, mood, or mode select. Continue to choose a source and/or a fixed fallback from its available options.
data_description.auto_on_transition: Optional. Fade-in time for automatic turn-ons. Manual turn-ons are unaffected; blank or 0 sends no transition.
data_description.auto_off_transition: Optional. Fade-out time for automatic turn-offs (timer expiry, turning bright, window end). A manual off is always instant.

warning.name: Off warning sequence
warning.description: Warn before an automatic turn-off: a brief attention cue (effect), then a grace period at a holding brightness (warn). A stage with duration 0 is skipped — leave both at 0 to turn straight off.

data_description.effect_timeout: Show a brief warning cue (dip or blink) for this many seconds before an automatic turn-off. 0 skips the cue.
data_description.effect_brightness: Brightness during the warning cue. 0 blinks the lights fully off — a hard-to-miss flash.
data_description.effect_rgb_color: Optional. Color during the warning cue, for lights that can show it. Needs an effect brightness above 0; any re-trigger restores the previous color.
data_description.effect_transition: Optional. Fade time into the effect brightness; must fit within the effect warning duration.
data_description.warn_timeout: After the cue, keep the lights on this many more seconds so you can re-trigger them before they turn off. 0 skips the grace period.
data_description.warn_brightness: Optional. Brightness during the grace period; blank keeps the brightness the lights already had.
data_description.warn_rgb_color: Optional. Color during the grace period — e.g. red as an unmissable about-to-turn-off cue. Lights that can't show color just use the warning brightness; blank keeps the color the lights already had.
data_description.warn_transition: Optional. Fade time into the warning brightness; must fit within the grace period.

occupancy.title: Virtual Occupancy Sensor
occupancy.description: Wraps one real motion/presence sensor and estimates when the person actually left, for accurate light countdowns.

data_description.occupancy_sensor: The real motion/presence binary sensor to wrap.
data_description.occupancy_timeout: The source sensor's own hold time, in seconds. When it clears, the moment the person actually left is estimated as clear time − timeout (the latest_occupied_time attribute, which anchors light countdowns).

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Expert tuning and a fixed entity ID — the defaults suit most sensors.

data_description.false_detection_grace: A cycle that ends within this many seconds after the hold timeout contained a single instantaneous detection — almost certainly a false trigger (a fly, a heat blip). Flagged so lights lit by it can turn off quickly. 0 disables.
data_description.clear_on_unavailable_timeout: If the source stays unavailable this many seconds while occupancy is active, occupancy clears so a dead sensor can't hold lights on forever. 0 disables (occupancy then holds its last value).
data_description.entity_id: Optional — leave blank to derive it from the name. A typed domain prefix is tolerated (light.kitchen → kitchen). Fixed once created; rename later via Home Assistant's entity settings.

combined_occupancy.title: Virtual Combined Occupancy Sensor
combined_occupancy.description: Merges several virtual occupancy sensors into one signal, respecting each constituent's own timeout.

data_description.trigger_sensors: Virtual occupancy sensors that can start occupancy — any one turning on starts it.
data_description.maintain_sensors: Optional. Keep occupancy alive once started but can never start it — e.g. a sensitive mmWave sensor that would false-trigger on its own.

data_description.entity_id: Optional — leave blank to derive it from the name. A typed domain prefix is tolerated (light.kitchen → kitchen). Fixed once created; rename later via Home Assistant's entity settings.

illuminance.title: Virtual Illuminance Sensor
illuminance.description: Turns a lux reading into a steady bright/dark signal that gates when lights may turn on.

data_description.illuminance_sensor: The real illuminance (lux) sensor to wrap.
data_description.illuminance_threshold: Lux level at or above which it counts as bright (sensor on, no artificial light needed); below it counts as dark (sensor off).
data_description.illuminance_hysteresis: Dead band that stops flapping around the threshold: becomes bright only at threshold + hysteresis, dark only below threshold − hysteresis. 0 disables.

data_description.entity_id: Optional — leave blank to derive it from the name. A typed domain prefix is tolerated (light.kitchen → kitchen). Fixed once created; rename later via Home Assistant's entity settings.

schedule.title: Virtual Schedule Sensor
schedule.description: On while the current time is inside the window. Each edge is a fixed time, a sun event with an optional offset, or both combined — e.g. start at the later of sunset − 15 min and 21:00. Overnight windows work.

start.name: Window start
start.description: A fixed time, a sun event with an optional offset, or both combined.

data_description.time: Fixed local time the window opens. Set a time, a sun event, or both.
data_description.sun: Anchor the window start to sunset or sunrise instead of — or as well as — a fixed time.
data_description.offset: Minutes to shift the sun event; negative is before it (−15 = 15 minutes before).
data_description.combine: When both a time and a sun event are set, whichever this picks wins — e.g. the later of sunset and 21:00.

end.name: Window end
end.description: A fixed time, a sun event with an optional offset, or both combined. An end at or before the start rolls over to the next day (overnight window).

data_description.time: Fixed local time the window closes.
data_description.sun: Anchor the window end to sunset or sunrise instead of — or as well as — a fixed time.
data_description.offset: Minutes to shift the sun event; negative is before it (−15 = 15 minutes before).
data_description.combine: When both a time and a sun event are set, whichever this picks wins — e.g. the earlier of sunrise and 07:00.

data_description.entity_id: Optional — leave blank to derive it from the name. A typed domain prefix is tolerated (light.kitchen → kitchen). Fixed once created; rename later via Home Assistant's entity settings.

light.title: Virtual Light
light.description: Controls one or more real lights with automatic turn-off, optionally driven by occupancy, illuminance, and schedule sensors. Use it in dashboards in place of the real lights.

data_description.lights: The real lights this virtual light turns on and off as one.
data_description.light_timeout: Seconds the lights stay on after the last activity — or after occupancy clears — before turning off. Must be at least the referenced occupancy sensor's timeout (if one is specified).

light_selection.title: Turn-on selection
light_selection.description: Choose how MoLight resolves the option sent to {entity_id}. The source entity wins when usable; the fixed option is its fallback.

data_description.turn_on_select_source_entity: Optional. At each off-to-on transition, copy the current state of this input_select or select into the target. Changes while the light is already on are not applied.
data_description.turn_on_select_option: Optional when a source is set; otherwise required. Choose from the target entity's available options. Used directly when there is no source, or as the fallback when the source is unavailable, unknown, or not accepted by the target.

remote.title: Virtual Remote
remote.description: Drive lights with the buttons of a remote control — any remote whose buttons appear as event entities (an IKEA Bilresa, a Hue dimmer, ...). Lutron Caséta Picos need the lutron-caseta-events integration installed to expose their buttons as event entities. Bind single or double clicks to actions; whether a button supports double clicks is read from the button itself. Presses count as manual control on a MoLight virtual light: never gated, and they cancel a pending off-warning.

data_description.target_lights: The lights every bound button drives — usually a MoLight virtual light, but any light works.
data_description.dim_step: Percent added or removed per brightness up/down click. Stepping up from off turns the lights on dim; stepping below the minimum turns them off.

turn_on.name: Turn on
turn_on.description: Buttons that turn the lights on.

turn_off.name: Turn off
turn_off.description: Buttons that turn the lights off.

brightness_up.name: Brightness up
brightness_up.description: Buttons that step the brightness up by the brightness step. A press while the lights are off turns them on dim.

brightness_down.name: Brightness down
brightness_down.description: Buttons that step the brightness down by the brightness step. Stepping below the minimum turns the lights off.

preset_1.name: Preset 1
preset_1.description: Buttons that turn the lights on at a fixed brightness and/or color — a Pico's favorite button. Set a color temperature or a color, not both.

preset_2.name: Preset 2
preset_2.description: A second fixed brightness/color preset. Set a color temperature or a color, not both.

confirm_entity_id.title: Entity ID already exists
confirm_entity_id.description: An entity with the ID `{entity_id}` already exists, so Home Assistant will create `{entity_id}_2` instead. Set an Entity ID on the previous step to avoid this.

menu_options.entity_id_change: Go back and set an Entity ID

error.trigger_sensors_required: At least one trigger sensor is required.
error.combined_occupancy_cycle: Combined occupancy sensors cannot reference themselves, directly or through another combined sensor.
error.occupancy_sensor_role_overlap: An occupancy sensor cannot be both a trigger sensor and a maintain sensor.
error.occupancy_source_molight: Select a physical occupancy sensor, not an occupancy sensor created by MoLight.
error.lights_required: At least one light is required.
error.light_timeout_too_short: The turn-off timeout must be at least the timeout of the selected occupancy sensor.
error.occupancy_timeout_too_long: This timeout exceeds the turn-off timeout of a virtual light that uses this sensor.
error.window_incomplete: Incomplete window: both the start and the end need a time and/or a sun event.
error.window_required: A window is required: give both the start and the end a time and/or a sun event.
error.entity_id_conflict: That entity ID is already in use. Choose a different one, or leave it blank to derive one from the name.
error.effect_transition_too_long: The effect fade must not exceed the effect warning duration (and the effect stage must be enabled).
error.warn_transition_too_long: The warning fade must not exceed the warning grace period (and the warning stage must be enabled).
error.no_filter_matches: Nothing matches these filters. Adjust them, or clear them to see every candidate.
error.no_entities_selected: Select at least one entity to add.
error.auto_on_color_conflict: Set either the auto-on color temperature or the auto-on color, not both.
error.turn_on_selection_incomplete: Choose an option source and/or a fixed fallback for the turn-on selection entity, or go back and clear the target entity.
error.turn_on_selection_invalid_option: That turn-on selection option is not currently offered by the selected entity. Enter an exact option from the entity's options list.
error.effect_color_requires_brightness: An effect color needs an effect brightness above 0 (a blink fully off can't show a color).
error.effect_color_requires_timeout: An effect color needs an enabled effect stage — set an effect warning duration above 0 first.
error.warn_values_require_timeout: A warning brightness or color needs an enabled warning stage — set a warning grace period above 0 first.
error.target_lights_required: At least one light to control is required.
error.buttons_required: Bind at least one button to an action.
error.button_click_conflict: The same button click is bound to more than one action.
error.double_click_unsupported: A selected double-click button never reports double clicks (its event entity advertises no double-click event type).
error.preset_color_conflict: Set either a preset's color temperature or its color, not both.
error.preset_values_required: A preset with buttons bound needs a brightness, a color temperature, or a color.

abort.no_candidates: No new entities were found — everything eligible is already wrapped by a MoLight entity (or is disabled).
abort.discovery_done: Created {count} virtual MoLight entities. Edit any of them further via its options.
abort.no_lights: There are no virtual lights to assign this sensor to. Create a virtual light first.
abort.assign_done: Assigned the sensor to {assigned} light(s) and removed it from {removed}.
abort.assign_done_skipped: Assigned the sensor to {assigned} light(s) and removed it from {removed}. Skipped (turn-off timeout shorter than the sensor's timeout): {skipped}.

options.regular: Regular — turns lights on and off with occupancy
options.maintain: Maintain — only holds an already-on light on while occupied

options.entity_id: Entity ID only — the name stays as the original
options.name: Name — also changes the derived entity ID

options.follow: Follow — turn on at window start, off at window end
options.gate: Gate — occupancy only works inside the window

options.control: Control — dark gates turn-on, bright turns lights off
options.gate: Gate only — dark gates turn-on, bright never turns lights off

options.open: On open — turn on when the door opens (normal timeout)
options.open_close: Open & close — on while open, off when closed

end.description: A fixed time, a sun event with an optional offset, or both combined. An end at or before the start rolls over to the next day (overnight window).

data_description.time: Fixed local time the window closes.
data_description.sun: Anchor the window end to sunset or sunrise instead of — or as well as — a fixed time.
data_description.offset: Minutes to shift the sun event; negative is before it (−15 = 15 minutes before).
data_description.combine: When both a time and a sun event are set, whichever this picks wins — e.g. the earlier of sunrise and 07:00.

light.title: Virtual Light
light.description: Controls one or more real lights with automatic turn-off, optionally driven by occupancy, illuminance, and schedule sensors. Use it in dashboards in place of the real lights.

data_description.lights: The real lights this virtual light turns on and off as one.
data_description.light_timeout: Seconds the lights stay on after the last activity — or after occupancy clears — before turning off. Must be at least the referenced occupancy sensor's timeout (if one is specified).

sensors.name: Sensors & triggers
sensors.description: The virtual sensors and helper entities that drive this light — all optional. Each mode sits next to the sensor it applies to.

data_description.occupancy_entity: Optional. A MoLight occupancy sensor (simple or combined): turns the lights on when the room is occupied and holds them until it clears.
data_description.maintain_occupancy_entity: Optional. Holds an already-on light on while it shows presence but never turns it on — however the light was lit.
data_description.illuminance_entity: Optional. A MoLight illuminance sensor; occupancy only turns the lights on while it reports dark.
data_description.illuminance_mode: Control: turning bright also forces the lights off. Gate: bright only blocks turn-ons — use when the lux sensor can see these lights, which would otherwise oscillate.
data_description.schedule_entity: Optional. A MoLight schedule sensor that drives or limits the lights by time window, per the schedule mode.
data_description.schedule_mode: Follow: on at window start, off at window end (porch lights). Gate: occupancy may only activate the lights inside the window.
data_description.door_entity: Optional. A door/contact binary sensor; opening it turns the lights on, gated by darkness and a gate-mode window exactly like occupancy.
data_description.door_mode: On open: opening turns the lights on with the normal timeout; the door is otherwise ignored. Open & close: the lights stay on while the door is open and start the countdown when it closes, unless occupancy still holds them.
data_description.hold_entities: Optional. While any of these is on, every automatic turn-off is suspended — guest mode, movie night. Turn-ons and manual control still work.

behavior.name: Turn-on & turn-off behavior
behavior.description: Optional brightness and fade overrides for automatic turn-ons and turn-offs, the quick-off delay after a false detection, and a turn-on selection applied before MoLight turns the lights on. Manual control is never affected, except that the turn-on selection also covers manual Virtual Light turn-ons (never physical ones).

data_description.false_detection_off_delay: When occupancy clears flagged as a false trigger, lights lit by that cycle turn off after this short delay instead of the full timeout. Manually turned-on lights are never cut short.
data_description.auto_on_brightness: Optional. Brightness for automatic turn-ons (occupancy, darkness, schedule). Manual and wall-switch turn-ons keep their own brightness; blank leaves automatic turn-ons at the lights' default too.
data_description.auto_on_color_temp: Optional. White color temperature (Kelvin) for automatic turn-ons, applied to lights that support it. Manual and wall-switch turn-ons keep their own color. Set either this or the auto-on color, not both.
data_description.auto_on_rgb_color: Optional. Color for automatic turn-ons, applied to lights that can show it. Manual and wall-switch turn-ons keep their own color. Set either this or the auto-on color temperature, not both.
data_description.turn_on_select_entity: Optional. The target select entity to set before this Virtual Light turns on, such as a WLED preset, theme, mood, or mode select. Continue to choose a source and/or a fixed fallback from its available options.
data_description.auto_on_transition: Optional. Fade-in time for automatic turn-ons. Manual turn-ons are unaffected; blank or 0 sends no transition.
data_description.auto_off_transition: Optional. Fade-out time for automatic turn-offs (timer expiry, turning bright, window end). A manual off is always instant.

warning.name: Off warning sequence
warning.description: Warn before an automatic turn-off: a brief attention cue (effect), then a grace period at a holding brightness (warn). A stage with duration 0 is skipped — leave both at 0 to turn straight off.

data_description.effect_timeout: Show a brief warning cue (dip or blink) for this many seconds before an automatic turn-off. 0 skips the cue.
data_description.effect_brightness: Brightness during the warning cue. 0 blinks the lights fully off — a hard-to-miss flash.
data_description.effect_rgb_color: Optional. Color during the warning cue, for lights that can show it. Needs an effect brightness above 0; any re-trigger restores the previous color.
data_description.effect_transition: Optional. Fade time into the effect brightness; must fit within the effect warning duration.
data_description.warn_timeout: After the cue, keep the lights on this many more seconds so you can re-trigger them before they turn off. 0 skips the grace period.
data_description.warn_brightness: Optional. Brightness during the grace period; blank keeps the brightness the lights already had.
data_description.warn_rgb_color: Optional. Color during the grace period — e.g. red as an unmissable about-to-turn-off cue. Lights that can't show color just use the warning brightness; blank keeps the color the lights already had.
data_description.warn_transition: Optional. Fade time into the warning brightness; must fit within the grace period.

light_selection.title: Turn-on selection
light_selection.description: Choose how MoLight resolves the option sent to {entity_id}. The source entity wins when usable; the fixed option is its fallback.

data_description.turn_on_select_source_entity: Optional. At each off-to-on transition, copy the current state of this input_select or select into the target. Changes while the light is already on are not applied.
data_description.turn_on_select_option: Optional when a source is set; otherwise required. Choose from the target entity's available options. Used directly when there is no source, or as the fallback when the source is unavailable, unknown, or not accepted by the target.

remote.title: Virtual Remote
remote.description: Bind single or double clicks of remote-control buttons (their event entities) to light actions. Whether a button supports double clicks is read from the button itself.

data_description.target_lights: The lights every bound button drives — usually a MoLight virtual light, but any light works.
data_description.dim_step: Percent added or removed per brightness up/down click. Stepping up from off turns the lights on dim; stepping below the minimum turns them off.

turn_on.name: Turn on
turn_on.description: Buttons that turn the lights on.

turn_off.name: Turn off
turn_off.description: Buttons that turn the lights off.

brightness_up.name: Brightness up
brightness_up.description: Buttons that step the brightness up by the brightness step. A press while the lights are off turns them on dim.

brightness_down.name: Brightness down
brightness_down.description: Buttons that step the brightness down by the brightness step. Stepping below the minimum turns the lights off.

preset_1.name: Preset 1
preset_1.description: Buttons that turn the lights on at a fixed brightness and/or color — a Pico's favorite button. Set a color temperature or a color, not both.

preset_2.name: Preset 2
preset_2.description: A second fixed brightness/color preset. Set a color temperature or a color, not both.

error.trigger_sensors_required: At least one trigger sensor is required.
error.combined_occupancy_cycle: Combined occupancy sensors cannot reference themselves, directly or through another combined sensor.
error.occupancy_sensor_role_overlap: An occupancy sensor cannot be both a trigger sensor and a maintain sensor.
error.occupancy_source_molight: Select a physical occupancy sensor, not an occupancy sensor created by MoLight.
error.lights_required: At least one light is required.
error.light_timeout_too_short: The turn-off timeout must be at least the timeout of the selected occupancy sensor.
error.occupancy_timeout_too_long: This timeout exceeds the turn-off timeout of a virtual light that uses this sensor.
error.window_incomplete: Incomplete window: both the start and the end need a time and/or a sun event.
error.window_required: A window is required: give both the start and the end a time and/or a sun event.
error.effect_transition_too_long: The effect fade must not exceed the effect warning duration (and the effect stage must be enabled).
error.warn_transition_too_long: The warning fade must not exceed the warning grace period (and the warning stage must be enabled).
error.auto_on_color_conflict: Set either the auto-on color temperature or the auto-on color, not both.
error.turn_on_selection_incomplete: Choose an option source and/or a fixed fallback for the turn-on selection entity, or go back and clear the target entity.
error.turn_on_selection_invalid_option: That turn-on selection option is not currently offered by the selected entity. Enter an exact option from the entity's options list.
error.effect_color_requires_brightness: An effect color needs an effect brightness above 0 (a blink fully off can't show a color).
error.effect_color_requires_timeout: An effect color needs an enabled effect stage — set an effect warning duration above 0 first.
error.warn_values_require_timeout: A warning brightness or color needs an enabled warning stage — set a warning grace period above 0 first.
error.target_lights_required: At least one light to control is required.
error.buttons_required: Bind at least one button to an action.
error.button_click_conflict: The same button click is bound to more than one action.
error.double_click_unsupported: A selected double-click button never reports double clicks (its event entity advertises no double-click event type).
error.preset_color_conflict: Set either a preset's color temperature or its color, not both.
error.preset_values_required: A preset with buttons bound needs a brightness, a color temperature, or a color.
